name: Linnea Holm
bio: Linnea Holm edits Halftone. She spent eleven years as a picture editor before taking the masthead.

name: Mira Halvorsen
bio: Mira Halvorsen writes about infrastructure, from the transmission grid to the water that cools it.

name: Dessie Okonkwo
bio: Dessie Okonkwo reports on freight and the coastline it arrives on. She has filed from fourteen countries for Halftone.

name: Rafael Viana
bio: Rafael Viana covers railways, ferries and the timetables that hold them together.

name: Soo-jin Pae
bio: Soo-jin Pae reports on ground, water and the way both are photographed.

name: Arun Pelletier
bio: Arun Pelletier selects and edits the photography in Halftone. The pictures themselves are credited to their makers on the plate.
